newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LEICESTER WIN TUSSLE WITH WOLVES OVER ABORTED DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEICESTER WIN TUSSLE WITH WOLVES OVER ABORTED DEAL.

text.p: English premier league Leicester have won their 250,000 pounds ($390,000) damages claim against Wolverhampton Wanderers over the collapse of a transfer deal involving Australian goalkeeper Zeljko Kalac.

First division Wolves entered an agreement with Leicester to buy Kalac on the condition that Wolves could obtain a work permit for him. They then pulled out, prompting Leicester to claim a breach of contract.
The English Football League on Wednesday ruled in Leicester's favour.
Kalac played only one league game for Leicester before returning to Australia.
